name: get_joint_associated_diseases_by_HPO_ID_list
description: Retrieve diseases associated with a list of phenotypes or symptoms by a list of HPO IDs.

items.description: The HPO ID of the phenotype or symptom.

offset.description: Number of initial entries to skip.

label: Monarch
Phenotype
Symptom
Disease
HPO_ID

oneOf.description: List of disease names associated with the intersection of ALL provided HPO phenotype IDs. Returned when every input HPO ID matched at least one disease.

Returned whenever the plain list would hide something: one or more input HPO IDs matched zero diseases, a phenotype's associations were truncated, or the intersection was larger than 'limit'. 'warning' is present only in the first two cases; 'total_matched' is always the full intersection size before 'limit'/'offset' were applied.

diseases.description: The page of the intersection selected by 'limit' and 'offset', in the first phenotype's upstream relevance order.

total_matched.description: Number of diseases carrying every usable input phenotype, before 'limit' and 'offset' were applied. Use this as the denominator; len(diseases) is only the page size.

warning.description: Present only when a phenotype contributed no associations or its associations were truncated. Absent when the only reason for the object form is that the intersection exceeded 'limit'.

name: get_phenotype_by_HPO_ID
description: Retrieve a phenotype or symptom by its HPO ID.

id.description: The HPO ID of the phenotype or symptom.

label: Monarch
Phenotype
Symptom
HPO_ID

association_counts.description: Counts per association type, e.g. Disease to Phenotype. What evidence exists and of what kind.

description.description: The term's textual definition. The only field that says what the term means.

exact_synonym.description: Synonyms that mean the same thing, e.g. ['Epileptic seizure'].

file_source.description: The source file the node came from, e.g. 'phenio_nodes'.

has_descendant_count.description: How many terms sit below it, e.g. 347. A term with hundreds of descendants is a category, not a finding.

has_phenotype_count.description: How many entities are annotated directly to this term. Zero on a term used only as a parent.

node_hierarchy.description: The term's immediate super_classes and sub_classes. Where it sits in HPO.

provided_by.description: Which Monarch source supplied the node.

related_synonym.description: Related but not equivalent terms, e.g. ['Epilepsy']. Treating a related synonym as exact is a classification error, so the two lists are kept apart.

synonym.description: All synonyms together, exact and related. Use exact_synonym and related_synonym when the distinction matters - treating a related synonym as exact is a classification error.

uri.description: The term's full ontology URI, e.g. 'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0001250'. The resolvable form of the id.

description: Retrieve the HPO ID of a phenotype or symptom. Results are restricted to the HP: namespace (Monarch's underlying search spans multiple ontologies -- e.g. MP: mouse phenotype, UPHENO: cross-species upper ontology -- for the same query term).

offset.description: Number of initial entries to skip.

label: Monarch
Phenotype
Symptom
HPO_ID

items.description: One term with its id and label

total.description: Total terms matching, which is not the number returned

name: Monarch_search_gene
description: Search Monarch Initiative knowledge graph for a gene by symbol or name. Returns HGNC/NCBIGene CURIEs, cross-species orthologs, and gene metadata. Use this first to get the gene CURIE needed for Monarch_get_gene_phenotypes and Monarch_get_gene_diseases.

offset.description: Number of initial entries to skip.

label: Monarch
Gene
Search
Cross-Species

subject.description: Gene CURIE identifier (e.g., 'HGNC:11998' for TP53, 'HGNC:1100' for BRCA1). Use Monarch_search_gene to find this.

offset.description: Number of initial entries to skip.
